scope: Learned same-scene flower-repair recipe routing with held-action replay
summary: A ridge utility ranker trained on measured flower-replacement candidates selected the oracle repair in all nine held-action groups and reproduced the best safety repair with two rather than five candidate evaluations, but the repaired inspect-flower video still fails identity and control-motion gates.
evidence: The immutable training run outputs/flower-repair-policy/20260810T204236Z-8885faf5 contains 45 hashed candidate rows from nine action/campaign groups.

Leave-one-action-out selection accuracy is 9/9, mean oracle regret is 0, utility RMSE is 0.011606, mean gain over the generic first repair is 0.141195, and candidate evaluation count falls from five to two.
The inspect-flower replay uses checkpoint 03eb5bb60c49c85b33982128c4a505e9008a36a06bb8bac63e808e7197ded1f2 trained only on insert-flower and handover-flower.
The replay raises mean proxy utility from 0.535717 to 0.784225 and background/object locks from 0.000614/0.000451 to approximately 1.0/1.0.
The 124-frame demo has SHA-256 94c6e5221324762db9df98e5b893f113d7324d7acdb5aa541e601fb076cb9065 and its poster plus six-frame storyboard were visually inspected.
lessons: Measured candidate archives can train a small reversible routing policy even when they are far too small for video-model fine-tuning.
Holding out complete action labels is a useful first leakage control, while same-scene generalization still needs a separate group split.
Aggregate utility improvement can coexist with worse motion adherence, so the strict per-gate task decision must remain authoritative.
limitations: All 45 candidates share one source scene, three actions, and five fixed repair recipes.
The policy target is a deterministic proxy utility rather than human preference, contact physics, or real-robot success.
The selected inspect-flower repair has robot identity 0.712496, motion alignment 0.481940, and EPL minimum 0.449531, so strict task acceptance remains rejected.
The learned component selects post-processing recipes and does not fine-tune MiniMax-H3 or learn robot-base control.
next_actions: Collect multiple source scenes and embodiments with persistent stem-instance supervision and human semantic review, then evaluate with scene-grouped held-out folds and uncertainty-triggered fallback to the full five-round audit.
